title: Docs-naming team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/docs-naming.yaml, the team layer of the docs-naming plugin's settings, and for its personal sibling docs-naming.local.yaml. The keys are the file-name rules the audit, realign and gate-emitter skills act on. Keys, merge classes and resolution: plugins/docs-naming/reference/config.md.

roots.description: The trees the audit inventories and the gate enforces: git glob pathspecs relative to the repository root, or root objects that limit a root to some extensions and exempt paths inside it. A personal layer can only add roots.

rule.description: The transform that proposes a new name.

regex.description: The extended regular expression a basename must match to be legal. It is inlined into an emitted gate, so it may not carry a single quote.

exempt_basenames.description: Basenames that are never renamed, anywhere under a root.

exempt_extensions.description: Extensions whose casing belongs to their language, never to this rule.

tiers.description: How a reference is rewritten, by where it lives.

sweep_exclude.description: Pathspecs the reference sweep never reads and never edits.

sweep_exclude_sites.description: path:literal pairs the sweep never edits, for a site whose text matches by accident.

generated.description: Files produced by a command rather than edited. Team layer only: a personal layer that declares it is ignored.

redirect_map.description: Reserved for a site generator's old-to-new map; no version writes one yet.
